x: There was a considerable amount of speculation before the race as to the merits of Brian Trower and of course, D. Chevalier, who has been showing rapid improvement, could not be left out of the reckoning.
With our team at full strength, we must have secured a place. B. Trower was our first runner home in 10th position (29.08), G.

Front: B. Trower. D. Baulch
Back: P.Bagnall. J.Masters.,E.Gebbett.E.Patterson.C.Poulter Masseur.
Masters then pulled the "A" Team up to 4th place but Brian Trower showed his lack of recent racing with a rather slow time which contributed greatly to our subsequent defeat.
Next came Eric Bishop closely followed by Alan and somewhere in the forties Eddie Short and Brian Trower side by side. Bob Plummer was about 100th followed by Wally Wortley and Charlie Manning.
The only other thing that was missing, according to Charlie Jones, was "talent"! Brian C.
